verdict.rationale: WorkOS explicitly documents using AuthKit as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server to protect MCP servers, with tokens and scoped access for agent connections (workos-docs-8, workos-docs-27, workos-docs-31), backed by a first-party MCP server product (workos-docs-15, workos-probe-4). This directly matches the story of putting a spec-compliant OAuth flow in front of an MCP server for remote agent connections with scoped, verifiable tokens. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of token scoping in practice and no community corroboration specifically about MCP+OAuth setup.
